title: Sizing Technology Pilot (Army Call for Solutions)
noticeType: Solicitation (Call for Solutions under Army Open Solicitation W9128Z-25-S-A002)
description: Army Contracting Command-Aberdeen Proving Ground, on behalf of HQDA G-4, seeks mature commercial technology that captures body and foot measurements by automated non-contact methods and translates them into recommended standard Army uniform and footwear sizes. Current manual tape measurement at accession points causes bottlenecks and high uniform and boot return rates and keeps no record of sizing changes over time. Evaluation phases and required attributes are in Attachment 1. Questions were due Oct 13 2026. No set-aside used.
